# CodeRabbit findings for PAN-5320 (PR #5323)

CodeRabbit posted 3 inline finding(s). CodeRabbit is advisory: nothing waits for these,
but each one gets an answer, either a fix or a reply with your reason.

- Thread 4576870084 · src/dashboard/server/services/merge-train-board.ts:245 [Minor]: Discover candidates before collapsing member PRs by issue.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5323#discussion_r4576870084
- Thread 4576870085 · src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts:694 [Major]: Pass the MR URL's host to the per-MR GitLab reads.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5323#discussion_r4576870085
- Thread 4576870088 · src/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.ts:476 [Major]: Read every MR page before using this listing for readiness.
  https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5323#discussion_r4576870088

## What to do

1. Read each thread (open its link, or the code at the path and line).
2. If you agree with a finding, fix it.
3. If you reject a finding, reply on its thread with your reason:
   `gh api repos/eltmon/overdeck/pulls/5323/comments/<thread id>/replies -f body="<reason>"`
4. If you changed code: run the quality gates on what you touched, commit, push, then run `pan review request PAN-5320 -m "CodeRabbit <thread ids>: <what you changed>"`.
   If you only replied, you are done.
5. If PR #5323 has already merged when you read this, stop: after the merge Overdeck files a follow-up issue
   for every thread with no reply, no later commit to its file, and no re-review request naming its thread id.
